```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10.5,
fig.height = 7.5,
dpi = 300
)

district_name <- params$district_name
state_name <- params$state_name

source(
  "Staffing Report Generator.R",
  local = TRUE
)
```

```{r narrative_text, include=FALSE}
build_narratives <- function(sizex) {

  comparison_data <- chart.data.calc.fn(
    select.district.state.data.function(
      yearx = set.year,
      districtx = select.district,
      statex = select.state,
      sizex = sizex
    )
  )

  list(
    chart1 = chart_1_narrative_fn(
      comparison_data,
      select.district),
    chart2 = chart_2_narrative_fn(
      comparison_data,
      select.district),
    chart3 = chart_3_narrative_fn(
      comparison_data,
      select.district),
    chart4 = chart_4_narrative_fn(
      comparison_data,
      select.district),
    chart5 = chart_5_narrative_fn(
      comparison_data,
      select.district),
    chart6 = chart_6_narrative_fn(
      comparison_data,
      select.district)
  )
}

narrative_15k  <- build_narratives(15000)
narrative_50k  <- build_narratives(50000)
narrative_100k <- build_narratives(100000)
```

```{r CGCS_narrative_text, include=FALSE}
build_cgcs_narratives <- function() {

  comparison_data <- chart.data.calc.fn(
    select.cgcs.state.data.function(
      yearx = set.year,
      districtx = select.district,
      statex = select.state
    )
  )

  list(
    chart1 = chart_1_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district),
    chart2 = chart_2_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district),
    chart3 = chart_3_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district),
    chart4 = chart_4_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district),
    chart5 = chart_5_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district),
    chart6 = chart_6_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)
  )
}

narrative_cgcs <- build_cgcs_narratives()
```

```{r appendix-table, results='asis'}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

appendix_cgcs_table <- appendix_cgcs_table %>%
  rename(
    District = District,
    Enrollment = Enrollment,
    `Total Staff` = Total_Staff,
    `Pupil-Teacher` = Pupil_Teacher_Ratio,
    `Pupil-Staff` = Pupil_Total_Staff_Ratio,
    `Pupil-LEA Admin` = Pupil_LEA_Admin_Ratio,
    `Pupil-School Admin` = Pupil_School_Admin_Ratio,
    `Pupil-Total Admin` = Pupil_Total_Admin_Ratio
  )

kable(
  appendix_cgcs_table,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  caption = "Staffing Metrics for Council of the Great City Schools Districts"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("repeat_header", "hold_position"),
    font_size = 8)
```
